subject.name: Analysis & Approaches HL
subject.case_studies_description: This resource provides two collections of extended-response questions for IB Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches HL Paper 3. Our IB Exam-Style Questions, created by experienced IB math teachers and examiners, simulate actual Paper 3 format and difficulty. They combine multiple topics in unfamiliar contexts to develop problem-solving, modeling, and investigative skills. Our Topic-Specific Questions focus on individual AA syllabus subtopics, for targeted practice as you learn new content throughout the course.

subject.bootcamps_description: This resource combines Bootcamps and an IA Toolkit to support students throughout the IB Mathematics course. Our Bootcamps are carefully sequenced, intensive workshops designed by experienced IB Math teachers to review the key concepts, techniques, and problem-solving skills needed to achieve a 7. Our IA Toolkit provides structured guidance for the Internal Assessment, including how to get started, how the criteria work, and practical activities to help students develop, refine, and evaluate their exploration.

faqs.question: What types of AA HL Practice Exams are available?
faqs.answer: Revision Village has created three types of IB Math Analysis and Approaches (AA) HL Practice Exams: Popular Quizzes, a Revision Ladder, and Mock Exam Papers. Each of the AA HL Practice Exam types have a different purpose, depending on your aims and stage of exam revision. The AA HL Popular Quizzes are designed for students who want to test themselves on a specific concept (e.g. Complex Numbers). The AA HL Revision Ladder is designed to cover all AA HL concepts and progress by difficulty of question (easiest to hardest). The AA HL Mock Exam Papers are designed to simulate actual IB Math Analysis and Approaches HL exam papers; their length, difficulty and composition of concepts.

faqs.question: What are the AA HL Popular Quizzes?
faqs.answer: Popular Quizzes are one of the three types of IB Math AA HL Practice Exams that Revision Village offers. These short quizzes target specific concepts in the AA HL course (e.g. Proofs) and range from 30 to 90 minutes in length; perfect for a single study session. The AA HL Popular Quizzes are similar to the Questionbank section (focussing on specific concepts), however students sometimes don’t have the time available to practice all of the questions in the Questionbank. This is where the Popular Quizzes become very useful.

faqs.question: What is the AA HL Revision Ladder?
faqs.answer: Revision Village has pioneered a new type of AA HL Practice Exam to support the exam revision process: the Revision Ladder. The AA HL Revision Ladder has 10 levels which increase in difficulty. The questions in all levels of the Revision Ladder involve all concepts in the AA HL course, therefore providing students a starting point with their end-of-course revision. Rather than starting with Mock Exams or Past Papers (which are often too difficult to start with), students can start their end-of-course revision with the Revision Ladder, and build their confidence as they advance through each level.

faqs.question: What are the AA HL Mock Exam Papers?
faqs.answer: The Analysis and Approaches (AA) HL Mock Exam Papers are a set of AA HL Practice Exam Papers designed to simulate the actual exams students will encounter at the end of their Analysis & Approaches Higher Level course. The Mock Exams are AA HL Practice Exams that should be used once a student has finished learning all of the topics in the AA HL course. It is recommended that students use the AA HL Mock Exam Papers under exam conditions to gain familiarity and confidence on the difficulty and time duration of AA HL exams.

revisionLadders.name: Level 1
revisionLadders.description: Get Started & Build Confidence. Practice the easiest IB Math AA HL Exam Questions from each topic. Recommended for students starting their exam revision.

revisionLadders.name: Level 2
revisionLadders.description: Building Strong Foundations. Practice common IB Math Exam Questions from each AA HL topic that often appear early in Section A in IB Exams.

revisionLadders.name: Level 3
revisionLadders.description: Aiming for a 3+ in Math AA HL? Level 3 contains common Exam Questions from each AA HL topic that are easy-medium difficulty.

revisionLadders.name: Level 4
revisionLadders.description: Gaining Momentum. Moving from easy to medium in difficulty. Level 4 contains common IB Exam Questions from each AA HL topic.

revisionLadders.name: Level 5
revisionLadders.description: Aiming for a 4+ in Math AA HL? Level 5 is a true test of your knowledge & understanding. Practice common medium Paper 1/2 Exam Questions from each AA HL topic.

revisionLadders.name: Level 6
revisionLadders.description: Level 6 contains common Paper 1/2 IB Exam Questions from each AA HL topic that are medium difficulty, but more challenging than level 5.

revisionLadders.name: Level 7
revisionLadders.description: Aiming for a 5+ in Math AA HL? Mastering the Exam Questions in Level 7 will rank you in the top 30% of AA HL Students.

revisionLadders.name: Level 8
revisionLadders.description: Aiming for a 6+ in Math AA HL? Level 8 contains common Exam Questions from Section A & Section B (Q7-Q11) in IB Exams. Strong foundations required.

revisionLadders.name: Level 9
revisionLadders.description: Mastering the Exam Questions in Level 9 will rank you in the top 10-15% of AA HL Students. This level contains challenging Section A & Section B Questions from each IB Math AA HL topic.

revisionLadders.name: Level 10
revisionLadders.description: Aiming for a 7 in Math AA HL? Level 10 contains the most difficult & challenging Section B Exam Questions. Mastering Level 10 will rank you in the top 5% of AA HL Students worldwide.
